counterMeaning: Null means instrumentation unavailable in that revision; zero means measured no new builds.
timingScope: Synchronous elapsed call time, including instrumentation overhead. No GPU/raster completion, asynchronous paint, compositor, or input-to-present measurement. DOM timings include only work performed synchronously in the labelled call. viewportReadSyncMs covers controller reads on resize; renderer dimension reads remain in remainingFrameSyncMs. DOM write timings do not imply all subsequent layout work has completed.
method: Serial alternating revision order and A/B order across 12 pairs per phase, after 3 discarded A/B pairs. Fresh phase invalidates topology before every sample; cached phase reuses geometry but toggles options and rebuilds ground. Assets/JIT are not process-cold. 40 warm frames per variant. No screenshot/readback inside timing.
